shortDescription: Manages AAA server host configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: hwtacacs_is_public_net
options.description: Set the public-net.

options.name: hwtacacs_is_secondary_server
options.description: Whether the server is secondary.

options.name: hwtacacs_server_host_name
options.description: Hwtacacs server host name.

options.name: hwtacacs_server_ip
options.description: Server IPv4 address. Must be a valid unicast IP address. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters, in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: hwtacacs_server_ipv6
options.description: Server IPv6 address. Must be a valid unicast IP address. The total length is 128 bits.

options.name: hwtacacs_server_type
options.description: Hwtacacs server type.

options.name: hwtacacs_template
options.description: Name of a HWTACACS template. The value is a string of 1 to 32 case-insensitive characters.

options.name: hwtacacs_vpn_name
options.description: VPN instance name.

options.name: local_ftp_dir
options.description: FTP user directory. The value is a string of 1 to 255 characters.

options.name: local_password
options.description: Login password of a user. The password can contain letters, numbers, and special characters. The value is a string of 1 to 255 characters.

options.name: local_service_type
options.description: The type of local user login through, such as ftp ssh snmp telnet.

options.name: local_user_group
options.description: Name of the user group where the user belongs. The user inherits all the rights of the user group. The value is a string of 1 to 32 characters.

options.name: local_user_level
options.description: Login level of a local user. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 15.

options.name: local_user_name
options.description: Name of a local user. The value is a string of 1 to 253 characters.

options.name: radius_group_name
options.description: RADIUS server group's name. The value is a string of 1 to 32 case-insensitive characters.

options.name: radius_server_ip
options.description: IPv4 address of configured server. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters, in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: radius_server_ipv6
options.description: IPv6 address of configured server. The total length is 128 bits.

options.name: radius_server_mode
options.description: Configured primary or secondary server for a particular server.

options.name: radius_server_name
options.description: Hostname of configured server. The value is a string of 0 to 255 case-sensitive characters.

options.name: radius_server_port
options.description: Configured server port for a particular server. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 65535.

options.name: radius_server_type
options.description: Type of Radius Server.

options.name: radius_vpn_name
options.description: Set VPN instance. The value is a string of 1 to 31 case-sensitive characters.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.
